title: On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.02015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. translated_title: 论RLVR后训练中的语言漂移现象
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理模型的最新进展——主要由通过可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行后训练这一范式所推动——使其能够完成极其复杂的任务。然而，与其能力提升相伴随的是，LLM在思维链中越来越多地表现出语言漂移的迹象：不寻常的、非标准的、以及看似无意义的语言使用。尽管这一现象已被充分记录——并且可能损害思维链的可监控性——但语言漂移的成因至今仍知之甚少。在本文中，我们确定了语言漂移发生的条件：我们从理论上证明，RLVR的优化压力允许无界的语言漂移，而监督微调则不会。随后我们通过实证表明，语言漂移特别出现在对新颖推理任务进行RLVR训练的过程中——即当目标行为无法从基础模型中引出时。
tldr: 本文从理论和实证两方面揭示了RLVR后训练中语言漂移的成因：RLVR的优化压力允许无界的语言漂移而监督微调则不会，且语言漂移主要发生在基础模型无法完成的新颖推理任务的RLVR训练中。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically proves and empirically shows that language drift during RLVR post-training arises because RLVR's optimization pressure permits unbounded drift (unlike supervised fine-tuning), and it occurs specifically when training on novel reasoning tasks that the base model cannot solve.
